name: Get found
tagline: Be findable for what you do, where you do it

roadmap.note: Needs pages to exist before there is a directory. Under independent analysis - we will not sell rankings we cannot control.

marketing.summary: A directory of the businesses on MakerBay, searchable by what you need and where you are, with every listing backed by a real page that answers questions and takes bookings.
marketing.audience: Service businesses whose customers search before they call.

features.title: One listing, kept current
features.body: Your directory entry is your page. Change your hours once and both are right.

features.title: Findable by service and area
features.body: Customers browse by what they need and the suburb they are in, and land somewhere that can book them in.

features.title: Honest about what we control
features.body: We build fast, correctly marked-up pages and a directory worth using. We do not sell search rankings, because nobody can.

faq.q: Will this get me to the top of Google?
faq.a: We will not promise that, and you should not believe anyone who does. What we control is a fast page, correct local markup and a directory that is genuinely useful. What Google does with that is Google's.
